Database.//: SqlServer is the default everywhere, including Development, so a fresh clone runs against SQL Server exactly as it always has. Do NOT commit a different value: this file is tracked, so changing it switches the database for everyone who pulls.
Database.//local: For a persistent local file instead, create appsettings.Local.json (gitignored) with { "Database": { "Provider": "Sqlite" } }, or set Database__Provider=Sqlite in the environment.

JwtSettings.//: LOCAL DEVELOPMENT ONLY. This key is public by definition (it is committed), so it must never be used anywhere real. Production supplies JwtSettings__Secret from the environment; startup refuses to boot without it.
